purpose: Define the 1.4 reuse-before-extension rule: reuse existing semantic definitions, inherit Topics, compose Topics and operations, and add only irreducible new semantics or causality.

topics.name: Structural Closure
topics.purpose: Define the 1.4 reuse-before-extension rule: reuse existing semantic definitions, inherit Topics, compose Topics and operations, and add only irreducible new semantics or causality.

decision_order: extend architecture only for irreducible semantics
semantics.topic_rule: Topic composition is the preferred documentation/spec reuse mechanism for cross-cutting mechanisms.
semantics.duplication_rule: Existing canonical semantics are referenced, not duplicated for local completeness.
semantics.extension_rule: A new concept requires explicit owned semantics that cannot be expressed by existing definitions, Topics, operations, flows or composition.
semantics.gap_rule: Failure to express a required concept may indicate a semantic gap or Contract Format gap; do not work around it with private documentation semantics.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant semantics are explicit and deterministic.

hard_gates.condition: new primitive/module/concept created when existing canonical composition is sufficient
existing semantic definition duplicated solely to make a mechanism spec self-contained
Topic composition bypassed in favor of duplicate cross-cutting documentation
new architecture introduced without irreducibility evidence
missing semantics hidden in prose/private convention instead of explicit gap or extension

references.purpose: Only new mechanism causality is added explicitly.
Insufficient closure becomes an explicit gap rather than invention.
